behaviors: DELIVERABLE_C_MODEL_REGISTRY comprises exactly Tasks 1-5 and the C-owned model/benchmark seams; it excludes Task 6 and all joint Task 7 CLI, wheel, and installed-code acceptance work.

Task 7 is a later Deliverable-D-dependent integration gate. No C acceptance command requires tests.test_ml_cli, tests.test_ml_acceptance, tests.test_ml_wheel_resources, a wheel containing dataset migration 002, or a Deliverable D installed-code receipt.

Model, dataset, benchmark, artifact, scan, and benchmark-receipt documents are canonical append-only facts; weights, archives, indexes, and benchmark inputs remain checksum-addressed external files and are never SQLite blobs or Git fixtures.
The default wheel has no mandatory third-party ML runtime dependency. Optional dependencies are lazy, platform-specific, hash-locked, and identified by exact receipt digest.
Hugging Face execution is local-files-only with trust_remote_code=false, safetensors-only first admission, an explicit device, no CPU fallback, and no runtime download or provider-network call.

HELIOS_TITLE_BLOCK_OCR_V1 is TITLE_BLOCK_TEXT_REGION_OCR with CER <= 0.08, WER <= 0.20, sheet-number exact match >= 0.90, zero empty outputs and runtime errors, one warm-up, three measured repetitions, recorded median/p95 latency and peak memory, and accepted failure-set review before qualification.

No C gate emits ML_CORE_CODE_ACCEPTED or TARGET_MODEL_BENCHMARK_ACCEPTED. A real target benchmark may only be produced by production execution on the owner's Apple M5 Max with 18 CPU cores, 40 GPU cores, and 128 GB unified memory.

The already-integrated Build Fabric MVP is a frozen environmental prerequisite at exact base commit e73fb95d6c0d193b042741691a9db2c625a906e9. Graph manifests support only intra-manifest edges, so no cross-graph lifecycle node is invented.

This task manifest claims no provider handoff, source coordinate, installed-code success, real-model execution, or target-host success. Collection records the actual adapter; unavailable providers yield an explicit UNAVAILABLE or BLOCKED reroute.

capability: Freeze and deliver the isolated immutable model registry, local-only model adapter, and honest benchmark control surface without P0/P1A, engine, provider, or target-host authority.

block.action: Record BLOCKED or UNAVAILABLE in a new receipt; do not download, substitute a device, fabricate a scan, or promote an unavailable dependency to success.
block.when: An optional dependency, lock, admitted artifact, scanner, compatible device, dataset prerequisite, or provider connection is unavailable or mismatched.

block.action: Block qualification and target acceptance; preserve the exact failed receipt and require a successor identity for another attempt.
block.when: A declared benchmark threshold, failure-set review, rights/leakage prerequisite, exact runtime lock, explicit device, or real M5 Max host requirement is not met.

escalation.action: Report the exact gate failure and create an explicit successor task after at most two correction rounds; do not rerun an unchanged failing command.
escalation.when: A focused, affected-integration, or milestone gate remains failing after the allowed substantive corrections.

reroute.action: Create an explicit reroute event and replacement assignment that names the actual adapter; preserve target_host_eligible=false for any external session.
reroute.when: The assigned local adapter or identified external session cannot complete the bounded work.

stop.when: A change writes P0/P1A/v1/v2 engine stores, quantities, rules, pricing, estimates, approvals, releases, bids, drawings, provider credentials, runtime authority, or an existing Build Fabric manifest/schema.

deliverables: Strict immutable model, dataset, benchmark, artifact, scan, and receipt contracts
Dedicated append-only ML registry store and migration stream version 001
Portable external quarantine, verification, static inspection, and admitted artifact CAS
Provider-neutral protocol and lazy local-files-only Hugging Face image-to-text adapter seam
Exact OCR metrics, honest cross-platform host discovery, frozen benchmark runner, and target-M5-Max validation
schema_impact: Adds only isolated append-only ML registry migration ml:001_model_registry; P0/P1A, v1 EngineRepository, and v2 EngineStore schemas do not change.
Freezes model, dataset, and benchmark canonical protocols. Dataset migration 002 and dataset-intake implementation remain Deliverable D work after C integration.
